LOOK: Farmers from the Alyansa ng mga Manggagawang Bukid sa Asyenda Luisita (AMBALA), together with peasant rights advocates, troop to the Department of Agrarian Reform office in Quezon City on Monday, January 26, 2026, to protest the continuing struggle of Hacienda Luisita farmers to secure ownership of the lands they till amid large-scale corporate developments. The farmers warn that the planned projects could cost them their livelihoods and displace hundreds of families.

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
